title: Building separation within the site at least the Table 2.7 distance
text: A 2.7.1 Development complies with the separation requirements set out in Table 2.7.

replaces.note: 12/7.5/4.5 m up to 4 storeys, 18/12/6 m 5 to 8, 24/18/9 m 9+ by room type, to 3 m up to 4 storeys and 6 m at 5+; room types and averaging deleted

notes: Applies where the site holds more than one building or facing portions of a building. Measured from the outer face of the building envelope including balconies (Figure 2.7a). verify: 'Building height up to 4 storeys / 5 storeys and above' is read as the storeys of the taller facing building (building.separation_storeys), not the storey level of each facing portion. With no within-site privacy Acceptable Outcome (A3.5.1 applies only adjoining an existing dwelling), 3 m is effectively the only numeric within-site privacy control (C4P2-074). Application 'All R-Codes' is odd inside Chapter 4 Part 2. Table 3.5A lists separation against 'A2.6.1' (C4P2-007).

verified.note: Table 2.7 (p22) heads its columns 'Building height: Up to 4 storeys / 5 storeys and above' without saying whose height (the taller facing building or each facing portion).
